nights.title: Montell Fish
nights.name: Montell Fish
nights.extract: Montell James Frazier, also known as Montell Fish, is an American singer-songwriter. Formerly making music under the CCM genre, he switched to alternative R&B and neo soul. He has since signed to Virgin Music Group for distribution and released two albums under the deal: Jamie in 2022 and Charlotte in 2024.

en.who: Montell Fish, also known as Montell James Frazier, is an American singer-songwriter who has moved from the CCM genre into alternative R&B and neo soul. He now releases music through a deal with Virgin Music Group for distribution.
facts: Formerly making music under the CCM genre, he switched to alternative R&B and neo soul.
He has since signed to Virgin Music Group for distribution and released two albums under the deal: Jamie in 2022 and Charlotte in 2024.

de.who: Montell Fish, auch bekannt als Montell James Frazier, ist ein amerikanischer singer-songwriter, der vom CCM-genre zu alternative R&B und neo soul gewechselt ist. Für den vertrieb seiner musik hat er einen vertrag mit Virgin Music Group.
facts: Früher machte er musik im CCM-genre, dann wechselte er zu alternative R&B und neo soul.
Seitdem hat er bei Virgin Music Group für den vertrieb unterschrieben und im rahmen dieses deals zwei alben veröffentlicht: Jamie 2022 und Charlotte 2024.

tr.who: Montell Fish, diğer adıyla Montell James Frazier, CCM türünden alternative R&B ve neo soul'a yönelmiş amerikalı bir şarkıcı ve söz yazarıdır. Dağıtım için Virgin Music Group ile bir anlaşması vardır.
facts: Daha önce CCM türünde müzik yapıyordu; ardından alternative R&B ve neo soul'a geçti.
Bundan sonra dağıtım için Virgin Music Group ile anlaşma imzaladı ve bu anlaşma kapsamında Jamie (2022) ve Charlotte (2024) adlı iki albüm yayımladı.
